segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 Englishpod。 我的名字是马可。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about a very, well, it's a pretty important part of your child's education.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们要谈的是——嗯，它是您孩子教育中相当重要的一个部分。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Something that many schools do is they have a conference between the teacher and the parent.
segments.zh: 许多学校所做的事情是他们在老师和家长之间举行会议。

segments.en: So, you know, they can talk about how the child is doing.
segments.zh: 所以，你知道，他们可以谈论孩子的表现。

segments.en: That's right. So this is something very common in American schools and it's important to learn some of the words that you will hear.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以这在美国学校很常见，学习一些你会听到的单词很重要。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to our dialogue and when we come back we'll be talking about what some of these words and phrases mean.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听我们的对话，当我们回来时，我们会谈论其中一些单词和短语的含义。

segments.en: Thank you for coming tonight, Mr. Weber.
segments.zh: 韦伯先生，感谢您今晚到场。

segments.en: As a teacher, it's great seeing the kids' parents assist our parent-teacher conference tonight.
segments.zh: 作为老师，很高兴看到各位家长来参加今晚的家长会。

segments.en: Of course.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: I'm very interested to know how my child is doing and also get some insight from you as to how he can improve.
segments.zh: 我很想知道孩子在校表现如何，也想请您指点他怎么提高。

segments.en: Well, Alan is a great student.
segments.zh: 艾伦是个好学生。

segments.en: He's a hard worker and very well behaved.
segments.zh: 他学习刻苦，也很守规矩。

segments.en: However, he does struggle a bit with math.
segments.zh: 不过，他的数学有点吃力。

segments.en: I guess he gets that from me.
segments.zh: 我想他这点随我。

segments.en: I never did well in math when I was a kid.
segments.zh: 我小时候数学也一直不好。

segments.en: What can I do at home to complement what he is learning in the classroom?
segments.zh: 在家里，我能怎么配合课堂教学？

segments.en: Well, it's important that you sit with him and review his homework assignments and help him with math.
segments.zh: 您最好陪他一起复习作业，帮他补补数学。

segments.en: I would also recommend he stay after school twice a week for tutoring sessions.
segments.zh: 我还建议他每周放学后留校辅导两次。

segments.en: It will really help a lot.
segments.zh: 这会很有帮助。

segments.en: Thanks a lot.
segments.zh: 非常感谢。

segments.en: I will definitely do that.
segments.zh: 我一定照办。

segments.en: Is there anything else?
segments.zh: 还有别的吗？

segments.en: Um, yes.
segments.zh: 嗯，还有。

segments.en: Here's a notice from our financial department.
segments.zh: 这是我们财务部门的通知。

segments.en: Seems your child's tuition is overdue.
segments.zh: 您孩子的学费似乎已经逾期未缴了。

segments.en: Oh, yes.
segments.zh: 哦，是的。

segments.en: All right, we're back. So now let's take a look at some language takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了。 所以现在让我们来看看一些语言要点。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: First up in language takeaway, we have the key phrase here, which is parent-teacher conference.
segments.zh: 首先在语言要点中，我们在这里有关键短语，即家长会。

segments.en: That's right. So it's a parent-teacher conference, a parent-teacher conference.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以这是一个家长会，一个家长会。

segments.en: And it's basically a meeting between the parent of the child and the teacher of the child.
segments.zh: 这基本上是孩子的父母和孩子的老师之间的会面。

segments.en: And they talk about how well he is doing or she is doing or what she needs or he needs to improve.
segments.zh: 他们谈论他或她做得多好，或者她或他需要改进什么。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is something that can happen maybe twice a year, maybe four times a year.
segments.zh: 所以这可能每年可能发生两次，一年可能发生四次。

segments.en: It depends on the school, but it's just a meeting between the parents or parent of the child and his or her teacher.
segments.zh: 这取决于学校，但这只是孩子的父母或其中一方与他或她的老师之间的会面。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's very common with schools in order to make sure that the parent knows how the child is doing in school and can improve maybe.
segments.zh: 因此，学校很常见，以确保家长了解孩子在学校的表现，并且可能会有所改善。

segments.en: And one of the goals is to provide the parent with insight into how to help the child learn more.
segments.zh: 目标之一是让父母了解如何帮助孩子学习更多。

segments.en: OK. So insight is kind of like a better understanding of things.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以洞察力有点像对事物的更好理解。

segments.en: More clear picture.
segments.zh: 画面更清晰。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So I could say, you know what, Marco, I just don't get that woman, Cindy.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，你知道吗，马可，我只是不明白那个女人，辛迪。

segments.en: Can you provide some insight into why she made that decision?
segments.zh: 你能提供一些关于她为什么做出这个决定的见解吗？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you want some more information or some type of explanation as to why she made that decision.
segments.zh: 所以你想要更多的信息或某种类型的解释来说明她为什么做出这个决定。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so the teacher will then provide this insight by describing what he or she thinks about the student.
segments.zh: 因此，老师将通过描述他或她对学生的看法来提供这种洞察力。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And while the teacher went on to say that Alan is a great student, hard worker, very well behaved.
segments.zh: 老师接着说艾伦是个好学生，学习刻苦，也很守规矩。

segments.en: So he is a hard worker. That means he is this is not an address.
segments.zh: 所以他是一个勤奋的人。 这意味着这不是一个称呼。

segments.en: This is now he is a hard worker.
segments.zh: 这是他现在是一个勤奋的人。

segments.en: She is a hard worker. He is very well behaved.
segments.zh: 她是一个勤奋的人。 他表现得非常好。

segments.en: Now, this is a way to describe him.
segments.zh: 现在，这是描述他的一种方式。

segments.en: He is not naughty.
segments.zh: 他不是淘气的。

segments.en: He is well behaved.

segments.en: He doesn't talk in class.
segments.zh: 他在课堂上不说话。

segments.en: He doesn't cheat.
segments.zh: 他不作弊。

segments.en: OK, so what would be the opposite?
segments.zh: 好的，那么相反的情况是什么？

segments.en: You say a child or a person is well behaved.
segments.zh: 你说一个孩子或一个人表现良好。

segments.en: What would be the opposite?
segments.zh: 会是什么相反？

segments.en: I would say the the child who is not well behaved is naughty.
segments.zh: 我会说，表现不佳的孩子很顽皮。

segments.en: OK, so you say he is not well behaved or just he is naughty.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你说他表现不好，或者只是他很淘气。

segments.en: He's very naughty.
segments.zh: 他很调皮。

segments.en: He always starts fights in class.
segments.zh: 他总是在课堂上挑起打架。

segments.en: OK, now the student is having a little bit of problems with math.
segments.zh: 好的，现在学生在数学方面遇到了一些问题。

segments.en: And so the parent asks what he can do to complement what he is learning in the classroom.
segments.zh: 所以家长问他可以做些什么来补充他在课堂上学到的东西。

segments.en: OK, so to complement, you might have heard this verb before, but here it means something special.
segments.zh: 好的，所以补充一下，您可能以前听说过这个动词，但在这里它意味着一些特别的东西。

segments.en: It means to add to.
segments.zh: 它的意思是添加。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, OK, the boy, Alan, he's learning a lot in school, but maybe he's not learning enough because his math scores just aren't good enough.
segments.zh: 所以，好吧，男孩，艾伦，他在学校里学到了很多东西，但也许他的学习不够，因为他的数学成绩不够好。

segments.en: So the father wants to know what can he do in addition to school.
segments.zh: 所以父亲想知道除了上学他还能做什么。

segments.en: Right. You know, what can he do extra to help his boy so that will it will complement his studies.
segments.zh: 对。 你知道，他还能做些什么来帮助他的孩子，这样才能补充他的学习。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we have to complement someone as to say, oh, you look nice today or this in this situation, this verb we are saying to provide more support or extra help to something.
segments.zh: 所以我们必须补充某人，比如说，哦，你今天看起来不错，或者在这种情况下，我们所说的这个动词可以为某事提供更多的支持或额外的帮助。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I feel really good about accounting, but I want to take an extra math class to complement my accounting studies because I'm just not very confident in my math.
segments.zh: 所以我对会计感觉非常好，但我想参加额外的数学课来补充我的会计研究，因为我对自己的数学不太有信心。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Exactly. All right. So and towards the end, well, we're talking about how the child's tuition is overdue.
segments.zh: 没错。 好的。 所以到最后，我们正在谈论孩子的学费是如何逾期的。

segments.en: The teacher says the child's tuition is overdue.
segments.zh: 老师说孩子的学费过期了。

segments.en: What is tuition, Marco?
segments.zh: 什么是学费，马可？

segments.en: Well, the tuition is the fees that you have to pay for school.
segments.zh: 好吧，学费是你必须为学校支付的费用。

segments.en: OK, so maybe a private school will have a tuition. So a high school or an elementary school.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许私立学校会有学费。 所以一所高中或一所小学。

segments.en: But you often hear this in regards to college or university.
segments.zh: 但你经常听到关于学院或大学的消息。

segments.en: So college tuitions in America are very expensive.
segments.zh: 所以美国的大学学费非常昂贵。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And when a tuition is overdue, it means that it hasn't been paid yet.
segments.zh: 当学费逾期时，这意味着它还没有被支付。

segments.en: And so the payment is late.
segments.zh: 所以付款迟到了。

segments.en: The payment is late.
segments.zh: 付款迟到了。

segments.en: Now, a lot of things can be overdue.
segments.zh: 现在，很多事情都可能会逾期。

segments.en: That means they've passed their due date.
segments.zh: 这意味着它们已经过了到期日。

segments.en: A bill can be overdue.
segments.zh: 账单可能会逾期。

segments.en: That's right. So you should have paid your bill already, but you haven't.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以你应该已经支付了你的账单，但你没有。

segments.en: So it's overdue.
segments.zh: 所以它逾期了。

segments.zh: 艾伦是个好学生。

segments.zh: 他学习刻苦，也很守规矩。

segments.en: However, he does struggle a bit with math.

segments.en: I guess he gets that from me.

segments.en: It will really help a lot.

segments.en: Thanks a lot.

segments.en: I will definitely do that.
segments.zh: 我一定照办。

segments.en: Is there anything else?
segments.zh: 还有别的吗？

segments.zh: 好吧，流利表达里的第一个短语是 to struggle with，意思是“在……方面有困难”。

segments.en: So, Alan is a great student, but he does struggle with math.
segments.zh: 所以，艾伦是一个伟大的学生，但他确实在数学上苦苦挣扎。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So, to struggle with something means that you are having a hard time. It's difficult for you.
segments.zh: 所以，to struggle with something 意思是你做这件事很吃力。 这对你来说很难。

segments.en: It is difficult.
segments.zh: 这很困难。

segments.en: So, when I was a student in elementary school, I struggled with science. Is there anything you struggled with, Marco?
segments.zh: 所以，当我还是小学的学生时，我在科学方面遇到了困难。 马可，你有什么挣扎的吗？

segments.en: I struggled with...
segments.zh: 我在……方面很吃力...

segments.en: I struggled a little bit with history.
segments.zh: 我历史学得有点吃力。

segments.en: Interesting. So, for Marco, history was hard. For me, science was hard.
segments.zh: 有趣。 所以，对于马可来说，历史是艰难的。 对我来说，科学很难。

segments.en: But you can also use it for your work, right?
segments.zh: 但你也可以用它来做你的工作，对吧？

segments.en: You can say, I'm struggling a little bit at work.
segments.zh: 你可以说，我在工作中有点挣扎。

segments.en: Okay.

segments.zh: 他这点随我，或者她这点随我。

segments.en: This means that the child has the same problems the parent has.
segments.zh: 这意味着孩子有与父母相同的问题。

segments.en: So, when the parent was little, he had a hard time with math.
segments.zh: 所以，当父母还小的时候，他数学学得很吃力。

segments.en: He struggled with math.

segments.en: So, it's something that maybe he inherited or he got from his father.

segments.en: He gets that from me.

segments.zh: 所以，有时你会听到也许有人很固执，你说，嗯，你知道，我这点随我爸爸。

segments.zh: 所以，我们基本上是在说你在基因上继承了相同的特征。

segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Now, this is important.
segments.zh: 现在，这很重要。

segments.en: You might have heard the word tutor before.
segments.zh: 你可能以前听过导师这个词。

segments.en: I have a math tutor. But a tutoring session is actually the time you spend together with your tutor practicing something or studying something.
segments.zh: 我有一位数学导师。 但辅导课程实际上是您与导师一起练习或学习某事的时间。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, you don't have a class with your tutor.

segments.en: But a tutoring session is one-on-one.
segments.zh: 但辅导课程是一对一的。

segments.en: It's two people together, a tutor and a student, a learner.
segments.zh: 这是两个人，一个导师和一个学生，一个学习者。

segments.en: So, the word tutor can be a noun.
segments.zh: 所以，Tutor这个词可以是一个名词。

segments.en: You have a tutor, which is a person that helps you or you can tutor someone.
segments.zh: 你有一个导师，这是一个帮助你的人，或者你可以辅导某人。

segments.en: To tutor, which means to teach or to help.
segments.zh: to tutor 作动词，意思是教导或帮助。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.zh: 我很想知道孩子在校表现如何，也想请您指点他怎么提高。

segments.en: Well, Alan is a great student.
segments.zh: 艾伦是个好学生。

segments.en: He's a hard worker and very well behaved.
segments.zh: 他学习刻苦，也很守规矩。

segments.en: However, he does struggle a bit with math.
segments.zh: 不过，他的数学有点吃力。

segments.en: I guess he gets that from me.
segments.zh: 我想他这点随我。

segments.en: I never did well in math when I was a kid.
segments.zh: 我小时候数学也一直不好。

segments.en: What can I do at home to complement what he is learning in the classroom?
segments.zh: 在家里，我能怎么配合课堂教学？

segments.en: Well, it's important that you sit with him and review his homework assignments and help him with math.
segments.zh: 您最好陪他一起复习作业，帮他补补数学。

segments.en: I would also recommend he stay after school twice a week for tutoring sessions.
segments.zh: 我还建议他每周放学后留校辅导两次。

segments.en: It will really help a lot.
segments.zh: 这会很有帮助。

segments.en: Thanks a lot.
segments.zh: 非常感谢。

segments.en: I will definitely do that.
segments.zh: 我一定照办。

segments.en: Is there anything else?
segments.zh: 还有别的吗？

segments.en: Um, yes.
segments.zh: 嗯，还有。

segments.en: Here's a notice from our financial department.
segments.zh: 这是我们财务部门的通知。

segments.en: Seems your child's tuition is overdue.
segments.zh: 您孩子的学费似乎已经逾期未缴了。

segments.en: Oh, yes. I...
segments.zh: 哦，是的。 我...

segments.en: Alright. So, parent-teacher conferences, a very common thing.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以，家长会，很常见的事情。

segments.en: A very common thing.
segments.zh: 很常见的事情。

segments.en: And I think sometimes even a little bit scary for the kid because, you know, your parent is going to go talk to your teacher and maybe your teacher is not going to say great things about you.
segments.zh: 我认为有时甚至对孩子来说有点吓人，因为，你知道，你的父母会去和你的老师谈谈，也许你的老师不会说你的好话。

segments.en: Yeah, this is always very nerve-wracking for children because maybe you didn't tell your mom and dad what you got on your test in science last week and then your teacher will tell your parents and your parents will be angry.
segments.zh: 是的，这对孩子们来说总是很伤脑筋，因为也许你上周没有告诉你的爸爸妈妈你在科学方面的测试，然后你的老师会告诉你的父母，你的父母会生气。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, this is the time when the parents can be honest with the teacher and the teacher can be honest with the parents.
segments.zh: 所以，这是父母可以对老师诚实的时候，老师可以对父母诚实。

segments.en: That's right because sometimes teachers will have a file with maybe your test scores and they will show them to your parents.
segments.zh: 没错，因为有时老师会有一份包含您考试成绩的文件，他们会将其展示给您的父母。

segments.en: So, not only what you get on your report card but then you actually see the tests and it could be like you say a little nerve-wracking.
segments.zh: 所以，不仅你在成绩单上得到了什么，而且你实际上看到了测试，这可能就像你说的有点伤脑筋。

segments.en: I've also heard though it can be nerve-wracking for the teacher because sometimes teachers have to tell parents things that they don't really want to know about their kids.
segments.zh: 我也听说过，这对老师来说可能会让人伤脑筋，因为有时老师不得不告诉父母他们不想知道的关于他们孩子的事情。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: If the teacher says, hey, your boy Alan, he's not very good at math, maybe Alan's dad gets angry.
segments.zh: 如果老师说，嘿，你的男孩艾伦，他的数学不太好，也许艾伦的爸爸会生气。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And says, yo, no, that's not true.
segments.zh: 并说，哟，不，这不是真的。

segments.en: He's very good at math.
segments.zh: 他很擅长数学。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: So, it can be hard for everyone but I think generally they're very positive.
segments.zh: 所以，这对每个人来说都很难，但我认为他们通常非常积极。

segments.en: They really help the students.
segments.zh: 他们真的帮助学生。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, it's interesting and actually I haven't really seen parent-teacher conferences to be that common outside of the United States.
segments.zh: 好吧，这很有趣，实际上我还没有真正看到家长会在美国以外的地方如此普遍。

segments.en: So, maybe if you're a parent, you have attended a parent-teacher conference or maybe when you were a kid, your parents went to your parent-teacher conference.
segments.zh: 所以，也许如果你是父母，你参加过家长会，或者当你还是个孩子的时候，你的父母会去参加你的家长会。

segments.en: And if you don't have teacher conference, parent-teacher conferences in your country, what do you have?
segments.zh: 如果你在你的国家没有教师会议、家长会，你有什么？

segments.en: How do parents and teachers talk?
segments.zh: 家长和老师怎么说话？

segments.zh: 让我们知道。 我们的网站是 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
